verdict.rationale: Kong documents and exposes an official Konnect MCP server with regional endpoints, and hands-on probing confirms a live, auth-gated MCP JSON-RPC endpoint responding correctly (401 missing auth header rather than connection failure), demonstrating a real, reachable official MCP server for agent connectivity. Kong also documents MCP Gateway capabilities (governance, security, autogeneration from REST APIs) reinforcing first-class MCP support.
